sample_unit: observations (200 HealthBench Hard vignettes x 2 models x 5 seeds x with/without framework)

links.outcome: Clinical response quality, hedging, and clarifying-question rates with vs without uncertainty-decomposition framework
links.effect: Overall quality +17.3pp (GPT-4.1-mini) and +7.4pp (GPT-4o-mini), p<0.0001; hedging d=5.80 for GPT-4.1-mini; clarifying questions 97.3% and 73.5% vs 7.8% and 0.0% baseline.
links.quote: BODHI significantly improved overall clinical response quality (GPT-4.1-mini: +17.3pp,  p < 0.0001, Cohen’s  d = 0.50; GPT-4o-mini: +7.4pp,  p < 0.0001, Cohen’s  d = 0.22) while achieving very large effect sizes on curiosity (context-seeking rate: Cohen’s  d = 16.38 and 19.54) and humility (hedging:  d = 5.80 for GPT-4.1-mini) metrics.

unlisted_practices: Virtue-based stance rules (Virtue Activation Matrix) to make LLMs seek context and express humility
Prompting LLMs to ask clarifying questions when information is missing

screen.practice: prompt guardrails for uncertainty and humility (BODHI stance rules)
screen.reason: The study develops and experimentally tests a dual-reflective prompt/architecture guardrail framework (BODHI) on LLMs across clinical vignettes to evaluate its effect on humility, clarifying questions, and safety.

primary.practice: virtue-aligned prompt guardrails and epistemic uncertainty decomposition
